text:
omar: hi all, first day here. got an Okta invite but it failed with 'domain not allowed' — looks like it went to my old employer alias (omar@oldco.com) instead of omar@redwood.ai. can't finish 1Password provisioning or see the onboarding Drive. yubikey not delivered yet. who can reissue to my redwood address or give a temp workaround?
lina-peopleops: hey @omar, welcome! :wave: that shouldn't happen. i see an alt email on your google profile. i'm updating your primary alias and will reissue the Okta invite to omar@redwood.ai now. i'll also request a 1Password seat.
omar: thanks Lina. is it possible to use macOS passkeys until the yubikey arrives? prefer not to wait. also would like repo access for the infra primer.
lina-peopleops: passkeys are fine short-term. i'm flagging your account to allow platform passkeys. yubikey ETA is ~2 business days. seat request sent — seats usually sync in 5-10m.
chris-devops: for repo access we can add your SSH key or issue a temporary PAT. SSH key preferred. DM me the public key. quick gen reminder:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "omar@redwood.ai"
# paste ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
omar: DM'd the pub key. thanks. after the reissued invite i clicked the Okta link and it immediately showed "account already provisioned elsewhere" then errored.
sean-sre: that error usually means the Okta user created under the alt alias collided with the new one. we're unlinking the old address and forcing a re-provision. lina, can you confirm the old alias remove?
lina-peopleops: removed old alias and reissued invite at 2693456802 (subject: "Redwood Okta Invite"). added you to onboarding-readers group as well.
it-bot: INC-45172 created and assigned to people-ops/eng-infra for alias cleanup + 1Password seat provisioning. ETA 30m.
omar: clicked the new link, got to the sign-in screen, enrolled a platform passkey, but `op signin` still returns "account not provisioned". any immediate steps?
chris-devops: wait ~3-5m after seat add. if still blocked try `op account add --team-url https://redwood.1password.com` then `op signin`. if that fails ping me and i can create a time-limited team-vault share.
omar: tried the commands and now `op signin` worked. vault visible. repo clone succeeded with SSH. :raised_hands:
lina-peopleops: welcome aboard @omar! i'll DM yubikey tracking info and add you to #eng-infra and #onboarding. if you need a PAT for CI testing we can make a 24h token — say so.
omar: all good for now. one small question: i hit an SSO redirect loop when i tried to open the onboarding doc in Chrome — incognito solved it. is that a known thing?
sean-sre: yeah cookies/cached SSO sessions can cause loops. incognito or clearing cookies for accounts.google.com usually fixes it. If it persists, let us know and we'll rotate the Okta session for your user.
hr-bot: reminder: onboarding checklist item 3 (benefits docs) added to your Drive at 2693456838.
it-bot: INC-45172 updated: alias removed, seat assigned, yubikey shipped. resolved at 2693456842.
